description: SDK Review: A test document for reviewing the SDK.
display_name: SDK Review: A test document for reviewing the SDK.
long_description:
This document will show case as many of our features as possible in as little operations/models as possible.
This will then generate a SDK that we can more easily review than the test SDKs based on uber.yaml spec.

tools.name: tag1-post-file-with-encoding
tools.description:
Post File With Encoding

This endpoint tests the encoding field with multipart/form-data content type.
According to OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec, the encoding field is valid for both
application/x-www-form-urlencoded and multipart/* media types.

This test includes multiple content types for the file field to verify
handling of comma-separated content types in encoding.

tools.name: namespace-tests-conflicts-get-namespace-conflict
tools.description:
Get Namespace Conflict Test

This endpoint tests the x-speakeasy-model-namespace extension by returning
a model that references two different Pet types from different namespaces.
The SDK should properly import and alias both Pet types.

This endpoint tests creating with models from different namespaces.

a model that references three different Pet types from different namespaces.
The SDK should properly import and alias all three Pet types.
